title: Sliding down a rough slope
caption: Per kilogram: the weight's component down the slope is g sin 30° = 4.9 N; friction μₖg cos 30° = 1.7 N opposes it, leaving a = 3.2 m s⁻². After 4.0 m from rest, v = √(2as) = 5.06 m s⁻¹.
alt: Free-body diagram for 1 kilogram on a 30 degree slope: weight down, normal force perpendicular to the slope, friction up the slope, net force down the slope.
description: Weight 9.8 N straight down; normal force 8.49 N perpendicular to the slope.
Net: 3.2 N down the slope, so a = 3.2 m s⁻².
